examples.name: High-Frequency Sensor Data
examples.description: For IoT sensors sending data every second, need to see trends over time
examples.useCase: Temperature sensors, pressure monitors, flow meters
examples.memoryImpact: High - stores 2 hours of second-by-second data
examples.visualization: Shows 30 minutes of historical context when stream starts

examples.name: Real-time Alerts Dashboard
examples.description: For monitoring dashboards where only recent data matters
examples.useCase: System alerts, error monitoring, real-time status
examples.visualization: Starts streaming immediately with no historical data

examples.name: Financial Trading Data
examples.description: For stock prices or trading data with moderate frequency
examples.useCase: Stock prices, currency rates, trading volumes
examples.memoryImpact: Medium - stores about 24 hours of minute-by-minute data
examples.visualization: Shows 15 minutes of price history when starting

examples.name: Network Monitoring
examples.description: For network metrics with balanced performance and memory usage
examples.useCase: Bandwidth usage, latency metrics, packet loss
examples.visualization: Shows 5 minutes of network history when starting

examples.name: Memory-Constrained Environment
examples.description: For edge devices or containers with limited memory
examples.useCase: Edge computing, embedded systems, resource-limited containers
examples.visualization: Shows only 30 seconds of historical data

examples.name: Long-term Trend Analysis
examples.description: For applications needing extensive historical context
examples.memoryImpact: Very High - stores up to 24 hours of data
examples.visualization: Shows 1 hour of historical context when starting

guidelines.memory_calculation: Each datapoint uses approximately 24-32 bytes of memory
performance_tips: Use smaller buffers for high-frequency data (>1 point/second)
Increase look-back period for better user experience on dashboard load
Monitor memory usage when running multiple streaming queries
Consider data retention policies for long-running streams
